how: written to a spec by 12 parallel agents, then reviewed by 12 more against the same spec; 3 of 158 replies were rewritten by the review
why_not_a_model_arm: every checkpoint under comparison descends from our text base, and none of them wrote or trained on this text -- which is the whole point, after talker_texts_zh_v1.jsonl turned out to have been generated by sft_mindsurf_768
spec: natural Chinese assistant register, 80-160 Han characters, no markdown, no AI boilerplate, factually correct, and an honest refusal where the question needs real-time or location data
known_bias: an external author's register is its own distribution. A checkpoint is not rewarded for answering well, only for predicting THIS answer. Use it paired against a second independent author before believing a ranking.
